text.p: Financial holding Credicorp announed a $0.50 per share cash dividend and a stock dividend of one more share for every five held.
The company said in a statement the record date is March 21. The payout date for the cash dividend is April 14 and for the stock dividend April 28.

"Credicorp intends to announce and pay dividends to its shareholders on an annual basis," the company said. "Although there can be no assurance as to the amount of dividends to be paid, it is the current intention of the board to declare to the shareholders an annual dividend equivalent to no less than 25 percent of consolidated net profits of the company."

Credicorp Ltd is a holding company that began operating in October 1995. It is Peru's largest provider of financial services and owns 90.1 percent of Peru's largest full-service bank, Banco de Credito.

Credicorp said the cash dividend would total $35.8 million and the stock dividend "will result in the issuance of an additional 14.3 million shares thereby increasing the total number of Credicorp shares outstanding from 71.5 million to 85.8 million.
